source.rank: Not filled yet: rank is null until `node scripts/attach-ranks.mjs b1` attaches a Portuguese OpenSubtitles 2018 list (hermitdave/FrequencyWords pt_50k, licence to verify; the list is Brazil-heavy). Until then these words stay out of the frequency rounds.
source.lemmas: Authored for icanspeak Portuguese in European Portuguese (variety pt-PT; ptBR notes where Brazil differs), chosen by topic for CEFR B1, with what a resident of Portugal needs first. Level banding is our own, not the Referencial of any institution or CAPLE: the UI must not claim otherwise. gender = singular definite article: o / a / o/a (common-gender person nouns). IPA is hand-written, broad European Portuguese; ipaSource authored.
